due.what: A minute later: the rest of fill 2 was not paid and anyone may end it.

expiry.refusal: a fill ends after the time in which a proof of a payment made in time is accepted

learnt.what: Eight Bitcoin blocks later: the chain has learnt the last height of fill 2, and a proof of a payment made in time is still accepted.

no_market.what: A network without the market: every row is proven absent.

expiry.refusal: the chain has not learnt the last height of this fill

trading.what: An open sell order with a proven trade, a fill in progress that was paid in part, and a free address; a buy order with a fill against it. The chain has not learnt the last height of fill 2.

note: The proven rows of the market as the engine serves them (verifier-v4/fixtures/market-state.fixture.json, written by v5/tests/market.rs), each under a header signed by test validators that carries the application hash of the engine. Written by verifier-v4/src/market_tests.rs (V4_EXPORT_MARKET_FIXTURE=1).
